# GroundRise

> GroundRise is a premium done-for-you content agency exclusively serving real estate agents across the United States. Founded and led by Ethan Davis, GroundRise helps agents attract qualified leads, build authority, and close more deals through professional video, photography, and social media content.

## Founder
- Name: Ethan Davis
- Title: CEO & Founder
- Background: Began in graphic design, spent 3+ years in media and content — building brands, growing audiences, and scaling creator careers. Has worked with top creators and clients across entertainment, business, and real estate. Now leads GroundRise with a client-first philosophy focused entirely on agent success.
- Location: Omaha, NE (serves agents nationwide)

## Mission
Too many talented real estate agents are invisible online. GroundRise exists to change that — giving agents the content infrastructure they need to compete, stand out, and grow without the DIY overwhelm. Core belief: the most visible agents win, not just the best ones. Visibility plus credibility equals a thriving real estate business.

## Services

### Video Production
Cinematic property walkthroughs, agent introduction reels, neighborhood and market update videos, short-form social clips for Reels and TikTok. Content designed to build trust before clients ever speak to the agent.

### Photography
Premium listing and property photography, personal brand portraits, lifestyle and neighborhood shoots, drone and aerial photography. First impressions close deals.

### Social Content Strategy
Complete content engine for social channels. Monthly content calendars, platform-native content creation, hashtag and engagement strategy, analytics and monthly reporting. GroundRise plans, creates, and publishes so agents can focus on closing.

### Content Creation
Branded copy, captions, and messaging that positions agents as the go-to expert in their market. Conversion-focused copywriting throughout.

### Lead Funneling
Content funnels that turn audiences into booked appointments. Strategic lead magnet content, nurture content sequences, CTA optimization across platforms.

### Brand Identity
Cohesive visual identity and messaging so clients recognize and trust the agent instantly.

### Wholesale Deals (Select Clients)
GroundRise works with a select group of clients on off-market wholesale real estate opportunities. Exclusive wholesale deals are brought to a trusted network of agents and investors.

## Process
1. Strategy Call — Learn the agent's market, goals, and brand to build a custom content roadmap
2. Content Build — Team shoots, edits, and crafts the full content suite
3. Launch & Distribute — Published across platforms on a strategic schedule
4. Scale & Close — Inbound leads grow as content builds authority month after month

- Caption & hashtag copywriting
- Basic photo editing
- Monthly strategy call (30 min)
- 2 rounds of revisions
- Best for: Agents just starting their content journey

### Professional — $1,999/month (cancel anytime) — Most Popular
- Everything in Starter

- Bi-weekly strategy calls
- Stories & Reels content
- Priority support
- Best for: Growth-focused agents

### Partnership — Custom pricing (cancel anytime)
- Everything in Professional
- Full dedicated content team
- Unlimited posts and content
- 8+ videos per month
- Drone and aerial photography
- Weekly strategy calls
- Wholesale deal access
- Unlimited revisions
- White-glove onboarding
- Best for: Top producers ready to scale
